name: investment-funds-reits
description: Use this skill whenever a regulated investment fund, hedge fund, private equity fund, real estate investment trust (REIT), UCITS, AIF, mutual fund, or fund manager asks about sector-specific tax. Trigger on phrases like "UCITS tax", "AIFMD", "RAIF", "SIF", "SICAR", "FCP", "FCPR", "SLP", "ELTIF", "PE fund", "carried interest tax", "carry", "promote", "GP / LP allocation", "K-1", "PFIC", "QEF election", "CFC for funds", "REIT", "Section 856-860", "PID", "UK REIT", "SOCIMI", "S-REIT Singapore", "J-REIT Japan", "Master fund / feeder fund", "Investment Tax Act Germany", "tax-transparent fund", "blockers", or any question on fund / REIT-specific tax. Covers UCITS / AIF tax interaction, fund-level vs investor-level taxation, REIT regimes globally (US, UK, France, Germany, Netherlands, Spain SOCIMI, Australia AREIT, Singapore S-REIT, Japan J-REIT), carried interest tax (US, UK, France, Italy), and PFIC vs QEF mechanics for US-taxable investors. Does NOT cover: fund formation, AIFMD authorisati
